scenes.before: Handmade soy candle. High quality. Great gift for anyone! Smells amazing.
scenes.after: Cedar and clove soy candle, hand-poured into an 8 oz tin. Smells like a cabin in October. Trim the wick to a quarter inch before each burn. Ships in 2 days.

scenes.title: Want the **listing prompt** pack?
scenes.dm: Counted! The pack with the most comments gets built first.

caption:
Same candle, two listings. Specific details help a shopper picture it. 🕯️

The second listing came from a prompt: give the product facts, the buyer, and the feeling, and ask for specifics instead of adjectives.

Sell online? Comment SELLER and I'll build a pack of product-listing prompts if enough of you ask. Only describe what is true about your product.

The product and wording are examples.
